name: near_ball plan_v4: the tracker writes every detection
owner request: Lancer ~4,3 h (GPU detection pass, then the fix scored on CPU)
why: plan_v3: the tracker loses 10.2 of the 11.4 points between the raw detector (0.867) and the output (0.766); sv.ByteTrack.update_with_detections writes only the detections matched to an activated track. The original runs' detection caches are deleted at run end.
step 1, GPU (Kaggle kernel veo-nearball-: The 223 units of actions.parquet; even frames 300 to 1125 (below the clip's length); yolov8s.pt, imgsz 4096, conf 0.10, NMS IoU 0.70, person class; every box saved (frame, x0, y0, x1, y1, conf). M7 / M9: opened clips only, through src/unseal.py.

step 2, CPU (Kaggle kernel veo-nearball-.both variants: detections with conf >= 0.20 (the pipeline's conf_player), fed frame by frame to sv.ByteTrack with the pipeline's settings (frame_rate 25 / 2, src/constants TRACK_ACTIVATION_THRESHOLD, LOST_TRACK_BUFFER, MINIMUM_MATCHING_THRESHOLD), the code and wheels of veo-code; rows below MIN_DETECTION_HEIGHT_PX dropped; then run_pipeline's fixed-view steps for players: the clip's outline with margin 10 px, track_kit_features, track_depth, assign_teams_v2 (hsv4, fit on tracks with depth >= 0.15); then player_filter.filter_players.
step 2, CPU (Kaggle kernel veo-nearball-.A (replay): the tracker's output as the pipeline writes it (matched detections only)
step 2, CPU (Kaggle kernel veo-nearball-.B (every detection): A's rows plus every detection the tracker did not write, each under a new track id of its own

stages scored (as stages.py): S1 tracker (after the outline), S3 team assigned, S4 roster cap (= the output's players, plan_v3 check)
measures: actor detected / taken / missed (eval_soccertrack_v2.match_feet, 43 px); control (other outfield players on the same frames detected); detections not matched to a truth person per action frame; same track over +-1 s for detected actors (as near_ball.py).
reproduction check: A's actor detected at S1 and S4 against stages.json (0.778, 0.766); reported, and a gap above 0.02 at S4 is flagged (the tracker here starts at frame 300, the original at 0). B is judged against A, under the same conditions.
primary: actor detected at S4, B - A; 95% bootstrap over matches (5,000 draws, seed 0, paired); per match
bar (B goes to a full pipeline run, even: gain >= 0.03 with the interval's lower bound > 0, AND unmatched detections per action frame at S4 <= 1.2 x A's, AND the control at S4 not below A's by more than 0.01
also reported: B's stages S1 / S3 / S4 (where B loses what it gains), A and B same-track +-1 s
kept: the detections stay as the GPU kernel's output (and locally if disk allows) for later tracker variants, each under its own plan
unseal: M7 / M9 opened clips through src/unseal.py, logged.
